title: Grok Imagine Image 2.0 was introduced through an xAI product-news entry
summary: On 2026-08-10, xAI associated a dated product-news entry with Grok Imagine Image 2.0 and linked readers to Grok Imagine. This is a material development step because it establishes a public product-line milestone, although the supplied evidence does not establish its capabilities, availability, or release terms.
